description: This file defines a repository class for managing user feature flags using Prisma ORM, including methods for CRUD operations, feature checks, and hierarchical team membership queries.

classes.name: PrismaUserFeatureRepository
classes.description: Implements user feature flag management with Prisma, including hierarchical team feature checks.

methods.name: findByUserIdAndFeatureId
methods.description: Retrieves a user feature record by user ID and feature ID.

methods.name: findByUserIdAndFeatureIds
methods.description: Retrieves multiple user feature records for a list of feature IDs.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Creates or updates a user feature record.

methods.name: findAutoOptInByUserId
methods.description: Checks if user has auto opt-in enabled.

methods.name: setAutoOptIn
methods.description: Sets auto opt-in status for a user.

methods.name: checkIfUserHasFeature
methods.description: Checks if user has a specific feature, considering hierarchy.

methods.name: checkIfUserHasFeatureNonHierarchical
methods.description: Checks if user has a feature, ignoring hierarchy.

methods.name: checkIfUserBelongsToTeamWithFeature
methods.description: Recursively checks team hierarchy for feature assignment.

methods.name: checkIfUserBelongsToTeamWithFeatureNonHierarchical
methods.description: Checks team membership for feature without hierarchy.
